terminal_name: Montego Bay LNG Terminal / Old Harbour FSRU
topic: Excelerate Energy acquisition of NFE Jamaica assets (closed May 2025)
wiki_text: On 14 May 2025, Excelerate Energy (NYSE: EE) closed its acquisition of New Fortress Energy's business in Jamaica for an initial purchase price of US$1.055 billion in cash. The acquired assets comprise the Montego Bay LNG terminal, the Old Harbour LNG terminal (Hoegh Gallant FSRU), and the Clarendon combined heat and power plant. The transaction made Excelerate the operator of Jamaica's LNG import infrastructure and was financed via roughly US$1.0 billion in equity and debt raised in Q2 2025.
